dimensions.assessment: Affects current and retired federal law enforcement officers who wish to purchase their retired service weapons.
dimensions.evidence: a Federal law enforcement officer may purchase a retired firearm

dimensions.assessment: Provides an administrative purchasing option for individual officers without broader national policy changes.
dimensions.evidence: purchase a retired firearm from the Federal agency that issued the firearm

dimensions.assessment: Generates minor revenue through the sale of surplus firearms at salvage value.
dimensions.evidence: sold at the salvage value for such firearm

dimensions.assessment: Directs the GSA to set up a specific surplus property purchasing program for federal law enforcement.
dimensions.evidence: Administrator of General Services shall establish a program

dimensions.assessment: Establishes an ongoing program following a 1-year implementation window.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act

missing_information: Expected total revenue or number of eligible firearms is not quantified.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the General Services Administration to establish a program allowing federal law enforcement officers to purchase retired service weapons at salvage value.
